question: Find the value of 6 ÷ [4 × 3 {5 × 4 ÷ (5 of 4 + 4 ÷ 2 × 4)}].
solution:
Concept: 

B = Bar/Bracket, O = Off, D = Division, M = Multiplication

A = Addition, S = Subtraction

Calculation:

6 ÷ [4 × 3 {5 × 4 ÷ (5 of 4 + 4 ÷ 2 × 4)}]

⇒ 6 ÷ [4 × 3 {5 × 4 ÷ (20 + 4 ÷ 2 × 4)}]

⇒ 6 ÷ [4 × 3 {5 × 4 ÷ (20 + 2 × 4)}]

⇒ 6 ÷ [4 × 3 {5 × 4 ÷ (20 + 8)}]

⇒ 6 ÷ [4 × 3 {5 × 4 ÷ 28}]

⇒ 6 ÷ [4 × 3 {5 × 1over7}]

⇒ 6 ÷ [4 × 3 {5over7}]

⇒ 6 ÷ [4 × 15over7]

⇒ 6 ÷ 60over7

⇒ {7over 10}

∴ **The value of the expression is {7over 10}**.
